## Technical analysis

### Day 4 of BUY Signal — First Flat Session: The $79K Zone Holds and the 08:00 UTC Pattern Pauses

Aug 22 is the first flat session (-0.24%) in a four-day BUY signal that has produced +19.7% cumulative gains from the Aug 18 re-entry baseline ($64,578 → $77,318). The session had a clear two-act structure: overnight bulls pressed toward $79K; morning sellers rejected them at $78,826; the rest of the session was quiet consolidation in the $76,965-$77,560 range.

The key technical read: BTC produced a **lower high** ($78,826 < $79,518) on **lower volume** (6,591 BTC vs 10,077 BTC yesterday) on the **first weekend session** of the current signal. None of these individually trigger step-aside, but taken together they establish the $79K-$79,518 zone as a double-tested resistance that will require a significant catalyst to clear.
